programmes.d: When Charlotte is challenged to a fight at school, Captain Man and Kid Danger step in to try and help Charlotte defend herself.
Dr. Minyak challenges Captain Man to a spelling bee.
When Henry's dad gets an offer for a new job in Bordertown, Henry and Ray go undercover to try and stop him from getting the job and prevent Henry from having to move.
When the Toddler takes control of the Man Cave, Charlotte and Jasper have to find a way to sneak in and free Kid Danger and Captain Man.
Henry and Ray try to help Piper get to know a new boy she likes from school.
When Kid Danger publicly breaks his arm, Henry and the gang have to find a way to keep his secret safe.
Lincoln and Clyde worry that they may be too old to still be playing Ace Savvy; Lincoln discovers that having a friend over means getting special privileges, and he takes advantage of that.
When Clyde thinks that his parents are having another baby, he seeks Lincoln's advice on how to be a big brother; a fight breaks out in the Loud house when Lori and Leni buy identical dresses.

Lana springs into action when she learns her favorite fish are in jeopardy of losing their home to construction; when Leni gets fired from her job due to missing scarves, Lincoln and Clyde, as Ace and Jack, take on the case.
Lynn's Table gets a bad review; the Action News Team must cater to Chandler's demands after he buys new equipment.
Lisa gets invited to work at an institute and get away from her crazy family; Lori and Bobby worry that long-distance dating is causing them to lose their connection.

Lincoln and his friends try to find another way to get to school after a run in with the eighth-grade bullies on the bus; Lincoln and Clyde are at odds when they discover there's only room for one of their grandmas at Sunset Canyon.
Lincoln and Clyde set Coach Pacowski and Mrs. Johnson up in an effort to make gym class better; Luan teaches Lucy how to manage the ups and downs of pursuing a life in the arts.
When the kids discover Myrtle has a shady past, they try to expose her before Pop Pop proposes; Lynn and Liam butt heads when they're forced to partner up as the middle school hall monitors.

To make it to school, the Louds must survive a monstrous Lynn when the weatherman declares it a Packing Day; when there are signs of a yeti in Royal Woods, the Action News Team sets out to prove its existence.
Lori struggles to make a good impression on Bobby's dad after accidentally pushing him into a puddle; desperate to have the best show-and-tell in class, Lily takes Lisa's shrink ray to school.

Leni and Carlota's working styles clash when they are both interning for a famous fashion designer, Mariella Moss; the Louds book a stay at an all-inclusive resort, only to find the vacation is not what they imagined.

When a sinkhole opens up at school, Lincoln and his classmates are forced to share lockers; when Lana brings home a skunk to rehabilitate, Lola grows attached when she finds the skunk has finer tastes.
SpongeBob tries to find a way to get Squidward to visit him at his home; SpongeBob must search for a new pair of pants after his square pants shrink in the dryer.

SpongeBob and Patrick dress up as Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy to attend a shuffleboard tournament in their place; Squidward is mistaken for his rival Squilliam and is invited to teach a class at a prestigious music school.

After learning about a bunch of eccentric holidays like Rock Day, Paper vows to get a holiday of his own; Scissors goes deep into his mind to decide on whether to help his roommates bring in the groceries.

Scissors blindly sells his likeness to a new company, which turns out to sell diapers for babies with huge poops; Rock tries to convince Paper and Scissors he is ready for a pet by taking care of a deadly robotic dog.
Mom and Dad want to renew their marriage vows on a knight adventure cruise, but they land on a knitter cruise; Mr. Bickles holds a talent contest, and everyone goes on, except Timmy.

Mrs. Crocker leaves Mr. Crocker home alone for the first time, and he calls on Timmy to teach him how to have fun; Chloe wants to break the attendance record, but Timmy tells her school is canceled and drags her to a taco stand.
Timmy and Chloe become mermaid eco-warriors and save the underwater City of Atlantis from a dangerous sea monster; Chloe becomes the hall monitor at school and takes the job a little too seriously.
Despite Timmy's warnings, Chloe wants to free the supposedly dangerous class hare; when Timmy's Dad buys the last Kale Patch Kid she needs to complete her collection, Chloe considers stealing it.

The Squirrely Scouts go into space to plant a flag on unfamiliar terrain, hoping to achieve a special Squirrely Scout status; Chloe spends the summer vacation studying, but her inner child disagrees and causes her to make crazy wishes in her sleep.
Timmy and Chloe help the depressed Catman prove to his girlfriend that he is a real superhero; Mr. Crocker teaches his nephew Kevin Crocker how to become a Fairy Hunter.
Timmy and Chloe wish that their families go camping together, but there is a feud between their parents. Chloe wishes to be a mother so she can go to Dimmsdale Daze Carnival with Timmy.

Mr. Crocker creates Wonky Cosmo and Wanda clones to get into a Fairy Convention to steal all the fairies' magic; Timmy wishes Chloe could live out her favorite dystopian movie but quickly regrets it when everyone is hungry.

When Cosmo loses the wands after Timmy and Chloe switch places, they risk being stuck as each other; Timmy and his father have some time to bond when they enter a film festival, but things get out of hand when Dad casts Catman.
After Timmy and Chloe save Dark Laser's beloved pet, Dark Laser becomes bound to them as their bodyguard; Timmy and Chloe wish up a girlfriend for Mr. Crocker to get him off their backs.

When Chloe's goodness threatens to drain the Anti-Fairy World Wand, Foop disguises himself as a girl in order to break Chloe; Timmy takes Chloe to meet Mark Chang so he can prove that aliens really do exist.
Timmy and Chloe must come to the rescue when Chloe's parents decide to return Cosmo and Wanda, who disguised themselves as birds, to their natural habitat.
Chloe wishes that an animal resembling Mr. Crocker would no longer be endangered; Timmy, Chloe and the fairies go inside Mr. Crocker to destroy Fairy Flu germs.

Chloe thinks she has a rash caused by stress and wishes to be a slacker, but Dimmsdale falls apart without her; Dad wants to catch a fish to win a trophy, but Chloe wishes all the fish could fight back.
Chloe's favorite cartoon characters come to life and brainwash Timmy and Wanda; Timmy's enemies learn that he is helpless without his fairies and try to destroy him while he is weak.
Chloe joins the Squirrely Scouts and saves the troop by helping them get their first merit badge; when Timmy and Chloe find out they have the same birthday, they decide to compete for the best party.

When Catman thinks Timmy has been kidnapped, he mistakes Chloe for Catgirl and enlists her help to save Timmy; when Timmy wishes that his father could be Mayor, he ends up getting tortured by the paparazzi and risks having his fairies discovered.

Timmy finds out that he has to share his fairies with the new girl in school, Chloe Carmichael, but when Chloe realizes she can use her magic for good, she wishes everyone in Dimmsdale would share everything, and chaos ensues.
Timmy and his fairies must save the city when Foop decides to make all of Dimmsdale unhappy by replacing everyone's pets with evil pets.
When Poof has trouble falling asleep, Wanda tries to help by reading him a book of classic fairy tales.
The gang searches through Cosmo's memories of his teenage years to discover why he never graduated from the Fairy Academy.
When Cosmo and Wanda bring Timmy back through time to meet their former Godchildren, his interactions with them alter the future.
When Dad forgets all the supplies for the Squirrely Scouts camping trip, Timmy tries to smooth things over with scary stories around a campfire.
Mr. Crocker becomes a teacher at the Fairy Academy; Poof begins to learn how to talk.
Poof finally becomes a fairy godparent, but unfortunately, he is assigned to Mrs. Crocker.
Squidward gets caught speeding and is sent to boating school; Mr. Krabs launches a tabloid newspaper.
Mr. Krabs interferes with Pearl's slumber party preparations; SpongeBob decides to give Gary a makeover before entering him in a pet show.

SpongeBob and his friends are swept away by a giant wave and find themselves stranded on a remote tropical island; to get back to Bikini Bottom, they need to learn how to surf from enigmatic surf guru Jack Kahuna Laguna.
SpongeBob gains a lot of new friends when he becomes wealthy; Squidward tries to avoid SpongeBob while on his way to an audition for the Bikini Bottom Men's Chorus.
Mr. Krabs offers Patrick a job holding a sign at the Krusty Krab; SpongeBob and Patrick are accidentally locked in a toy store after it closes.
Plankton hires Patrick to create advertising slogans for the Chum Bucket; SpongeBob helps Plankton find the perfect anniversary gift for Karen.
Mr. Krabs wants to manage SpongeBob and Patrick as a tag team wrestling duo; SpongeBob searches for a rare trading card.
The tiny futuristic city of Shmandor exacts revenge on Patrick Star; Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbors.
Patrick and SpongeBob work at the theater; under Sandy's guidance, Patrick hosts a science show.
When packages are stolen from Swellview porches, Henry and Ray set up a stakeout in an attempt to catch the thief red-handed.

Captain Man reveals a Crime fighters Only room in the Man Cave; when Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up, the gang fights over who gets the better room and things get blown out of proportion.
Henry believes that he is replaced on the basketball team by an older boy; Captain Man must overcome old grudges to get help from a friend.
